explanation: From main: CHANGELOG.md's Unreleased section records that Enter in the gene search selects the gene typed. No guidance, command, configuration or workflow changed. From this branch: Project guidance says a gene's survey lives on its gene page as one tile per source, each opening that source's survey, and that #/expression keeps multi-gene comparison, the catalog and validation, naming GeneSurvey.tsx as the shared workspace; the expression-survey catalog summary and the regenerated startup map agree. Project guidance says to run build:search-names after build:nomenclature, that it writes names.js and renames.js, that its --check fails when either is stale, and where its rule tests live. CONTEXT.md defines the rename group, its join rules and pickStoredMember.
